WITH promo_data AS (
    SELECT p.category,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.promotion_flag = 1 THEN s.units_sold ELSE 0 END) AS promo_units,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.promotion_flag = 0 THEN s.units_sold ELSE 0 END) AS non_promo_units
    FROM fmcg_sales AS s
    JOIN dim_product AS p ON s.sku = p.sku
    GROUP BY p.category
) SELECT category,
       promo_units,
       non_promo_units,
       ROUND((promo_units - non_promo_units) * 1.0 / NULLIF(non_promo_units, 0), 4) AS promotional_uplift_rate
FROM promo_data
ORDER BY promotional_uplift_rate DESC

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT st.region,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(s.date AS DATE)) AS month_start,
           SUM(s.units_sold) AS units_sold
    FROM fmcg_sales AS s
    JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY st.region, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(s.date AS DATE))
),
lagged AS (
    SELECT region,
           month_start,
           units_sold,
           LAG(units_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units_sold
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT region,
       month_start,
       units_sold,
       prev_units_sold,
       (units_sold - prev_units_sold) AS month_on_month_change
FROM lagged
ORDER BY region, month_start

    WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY p.category, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(s.date AS DATE))
),
month_lag AS (
    SELECT category, month_start, units,
           LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_units
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT category, month_start, units, prev_units,
       (units - prev_units) AS mom_change
FROM month_lag
WHERE prev_units IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY category, month_start
